title: One file, five speeds
audience: Developers deciding whether to present from an HTML deck instead of PowerPoint
goal: They understand how a stagecraft deck is built, checked, and played, and trust it for a live talk
register: technical, plain, confident; short declarative sentences; code names in mono

claims.text: Every slide is drawn on a 1920 by 1080 stage
Motion has five levels: 0 Still, 1 Minimal, 2 Smooth, 3 Cinematic, 4 Insane
The stage scales as a whole and never reflows per device
claims.quote: Never reflow slide content per device.

claims.text: build.py lints the source and refuses to write when there are errors
claims.quote: print("Not written. Fix the errors and rebuild.")

claims.text: GSAP 3.13.0 is pinned and can be inlined for offline talks
Canvas effects and cursor parallax start at level 3
Sentences over 24 words raise a warning

slides.title: Every slide is drawn once and scaled whole
Pick the energy for the room
The slower the cut, the bigger the moment

motion.concept: A print run. Pages are set in type, scaled to fit the frame, then scanned onto the stage line by line.
motion.feel: mechanical and exact: steps() eases for type and cuts, power4.inOut for scaling, short holds
motion.cut: scan: the next slide is revealed top to bottom in discrete steps, like a scan line
signatures: cover: the title is set character by character in stepped type
stage: 1920 by 1080 scales up into the frame
pipeline: the flow draws from source to checked deck
motion.still: body copy, keys and margins only fade
